items.title: Intelligence at pocket scale: Benchmarking small models and mobile phones
items.summary: Independent intelligence benchmarking of small language models on a set of evaluations chosen for mobile device use, launched alongside mobile phone inference benchmarking with Liquid AI. We evaluate the same quantized builds used on mobile phones, and performance is measured on real devices.

items.title: 我的 AI 原生开发流程：一个真实案例的完整复盘
items.summary: AI 原生开发没有抛弃传统流程，而是让人负责关键判断、让 Agent 执行分析、设计、编码与验证；本文用 BaoCut 远程转录功能完整复盘这套工作方式。
